review:
Chaos Crew 2 brings back punk duo Cranky and Sketchy with new features, higher volatility and, at the time, Hacksaw's biggest max win. It plays on 19 paylines.

A new drop feature can appear at random in the base game, giving an instant taste of the original game's bonus: special symbols land and reveal their values, then play returns to the base game. Cranky the cat acts as a wild carrying multiplier values that apply to wins he forms. Hacksaw rates the game 5 out of 5 for volatility with a 20,000x maximum. The top RTP is 96.27%, and lower versions down to 88.28% exist. If you enjoyed Chaos Crew, this is a much more intense follow-up.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 88.28% RTP
Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
